statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data
The service was rejected because it falls outside the defined parameters of the active policy
